name: Mereana

identity.role: Māori performer, teacher and visiting artist who organizes collaborators and protects their instruments, panels and choices about sharing performances.
identity.location: Visiting artist from Aotearoa, arriving via Tideglass
identity.cultural_identity_as_written: Māori performer and teacher from Aotearoa, explicitly established in The Shore I Choose chapter 6; not an inference from her name.

grounded_traits: pragmatic with contracts and technical handling
motivations: Declines an advertised performance that was never agreed
Seeks expert evaluation of warped panel
Requires owners' approval of packing and repair
Names the financial cost of missed work and delayed transport

voice.register: Specific, calm but uncompromising on ownership, repair approval, booking time and consent to perform
writer_rules: Keep this supporting character's concerns independent of Jasper's romance.
Never treat an unknown family history, appearance or title as a confirmed fact.

avoid: giving this person automatic consent to help or be publicized

source_evidence.evidence: Explicitly introduces herself as Māori performer and teacher, and says she cannot speak for all iwi or traditions.

known_unknowns: whether she personally made each panel
source_boundary: Original fanfiction character; chapter 6 explicitly establishes that Mereana identifies as a Māori performer and teacher from Aotearoa.
